interface.longDescription: SKILL ANALYZER 1.1.0 menggabungkan sepuluh spesialis analisis inti, lima cross-skill engine, serta Universal AI Invocation Gateway. Gateway menyediakan command registry kanonis, alias normalization, adapter platform, JSON invocation envelope, dan CLI untuk menghasilkan prompt atau request terstruktur. skills/ dan gateway/ menjadi sumber kanonis. Adapter tersedia untuk OpenAI/Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Cursor, ChatGPT package, dan generic Agent Skills clients. Gateway mempersiapkan routing, bukan menjalankan model call, memberikan permission, atau menjamin runtime behavior. Evidence Registry, Residual Unknowns, Trace Graph, FIRE, Capability Readiness, Change Impact, Controlled Experiment, dan Information Authenticator tetap menjadi kontrol analitis inti.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this problem using the four-stage SKILL ANALYZER workflow: select methods, investigate causes, challenge risks, and engineer practical solutions.
Audit this framework critically: identify evidence gaps, root-cause weaknesses, failure modes, and testable improvements.
Stress-test this strategy and convert material findings into preventive controls, implementation steps, and evaluation criteria.

name: skill-analyzer
description: Sistem analisis modular dengan sepuluh spesialis, lima engine, Universal AI Invocation Gateway, dan adapter Agent Skills lintas platform.
